measurements.start: System.nanoTime before worker launch or reference readiness marker
measurements.cold_cache: new empty per-trial directory and fresh worker/reference/JVM processes
measurements.presentation: same KMP renderer and settings for both engines
measurements.percentiles: nearest-rank p90 over all trials; missing timing is infinity
measurements.retirement: joined runtime cleanup or expected forced settlement plus actual child exit; unexpected failures fail trial
measurements.resource_sampling: 1 Hz aggregate owned JVM plus worker/reference; full trial including retirement; not a peak-memory guarantee
